categories.name: Success
categories.rules:
**General/Important Rules**

- Video proof **mandatory**. If a submission’s video is removed or otherwise unavailable the run will be removed retroactively.
- Time Trials must be started through the Main Menu and **not** in freeroam as the mission version. This is due to some missions having variations in the starting location, checkpoint quantities, and props.** - rule added/in effect Jan 10, 2023
- All submissions require some form of audible game audio.*
- All submissions require clear recordings, with functional framerates.**
- No timer exploits.
- No pausing the simulation/IGT.
- No simplified physics.
- No environmental manipulation (e.g., gravity, wind, etc.).
- Competitive scenario conditions are to be applied.
- Mods from the repository or any 3rd party mods are not allowed.

*Background audio like music or talking is allowed, but vehicle noise should still be audible.

**Recorded framerate consistently at ~20FPS or frequently dipping to below ~15FPS puts the submission at the risk of being rejected.

**Runs with IGT**

- Default IGT must be visible in recording.
- IGT displayed at the end of a mission is to be used as the submission time.
- If the default IGT is counting down: Subtract the time remaining from the scenario's original time cap to get your submission time.
- If there is no time displayed on the success screen, submit the last shown time of the IGT.

**Runs without IGT**

Use external timers (e.g. LiveSplit).

Start time from the moment you gain full control over your vehicle and stop the timer on achieving success (e.g. hitting the last checkpoint, finishing the last task, collecting the last collectible or when in doubt, stop time when success screen appears)

**Scenarios**

- Runs must use the default vehicle configuration that’s provided.
- Runs must use the default time and traffic settings.
- Runs which rely on buggy, "one-in-a-million" AI behavior are not allowed.

- If scenario doesn't have a timer, refer to "Runs without IGT" for timing instructions.
- Do not "submit score" to succeed early.
- No altering the AI’s behavior with UI apps and gameplay settings. (exception: “Garage To * Garage Delivery” noTraffic%)
- Vehicle hinges mustn't be broken with the UI app.*
- We are currently not moderating the "(N/A) Scenarios" section of the leaderboard as it contains all scenarios in which the goal is to chase down an AI driven car. These AI scenarios break and change nearly every update, so it was decided to postpone any submissions for them. Sorry for any inconvenience.
- In "Knockaway", do not stand still to succeed.

*Vehicle parts removed from damage endured during a run is acceptable.

**Time Trials**

- All runs are to be completed in 1 lap.*
- If given the option, Time Trials can also be done in reverse.
- Rolling starts are permitted.
- Fine tuning and modification of default vehicles using vanilla BeamNG is allowed.
- Time Trials must be started through the Main Menu and **not** in freeroam as the mission version. This is due to some missions having variations in the starting location, checkpoint quantities, and props.** - rule added/in effect Jan 10, 2023

*Dirt Oval has a 3 lap category, which is to be completed in 3 laps.
**West Coast. USA: Drag Strip is the exception to this rule, as the mission includes more timing data at the end than the Time Trial version.

**Bus Routes**

- Disable "Strict Stops".
- Fine tuning and modification of the default buses using vanilla BeamNG is allowed.

**Light Runner**

- All runs are to be completed in 1 lap.
- Only use the 4 default provided "PowerGlow" cars.
- Vehicle hinges mustn't be broken with the UI app.*

*Vehicle parts removed from damage endured during a run is acceptable.

**Campaigns**

- Timing is determined by adding the in-game time achieved in each level.*

*Except for "A Rocky Start", where the timing is RTA, but with the loading times cut.

levels.name: Scenarios - G2G Delivery: East Coast USA 40KM/24.9Mi
levels.rules:
**Garage to Garage Delivery Specific Ruleset and Timing Instructions**

- The goal is to reach the distance goal as fast as possible.
- Use a timer such as LiveSplit to the nearest hundredths of a second (0.00) to time your run.
- Specific rules for Traffic%: Have traffic AI enabled
- Specific rules for NoTraffic%: If you'd rather disable traffic through the UI app or it just doesn't spawn in for one reason or another, submit it under this category.
- The timer will start the moment you press “start” on a delivery and can be paused between deliveries after the end screen shows a successful delivery. The timer needs to unpause again the moment you press “start” on the next delivery and so on for subsequent deliveries until the total distance is obtained.
The timer stops when the success screen appears and the **Total Delivery Distance** either meets or exceeds your distance total for that map.
- During the run you are allowed to use up to 5 abandons, but any more than 5 abandons or 5 unsuccessful deliveries and your run will be invalid.
- Deliveries can be abandoned without using one of your 5 allowed abandons if one of the following is true: 

1. Your vehicle gets stuck in mud/sand that you had to move through according to BeamNav
**OR**
2. The Delivery contains one of the following vehicle configs:

> Any FPU Wydra

> Any Gavril T-Series

> Any Autobello Stambecco except "525-C-2 Rally"

> Any Ibishu Wigeon except "The Darter" and "The Mantis"

> Any Ibishu Pigeon except "Gambler 500 - Poogeon", "Drag" and "Race"

> Any Gavril MD-Series except "MD60 Skid-Brick", "MD60 Tow Rig", "MD60 Crew Cab Custom" and "MD70 Mini Destroyer"

> Autobello Piccolina (any)"110" or "Tricolore"

> Gavril H-Series "The Vantastic"

> Ibishu Covet "Guinea Pig" or "The Skidplate"

> Bruckell Nine "Short Bed Pickup", "Nine Coupe", "Short Panel Van", "Sedan", "Taxi", "Roadster" or "Overlander"

- If you decide to abandon a delivery right from the start, just leave your timer paused while you do so, and unpause whenever your next delivery starts. When abandoning during a delivery, you may pause the timer after the game prompt displays asking if you want to abandon or continue the delivery. When abandoning a delivery half way through, your time spent on that unsuccessful delivery until the timer pauses after the game prompt displays will count towards your total time.

*HINTS:*

- Pass the traffic AI on the shoulder, or assume the traffic AI knows which side you’re passing on and wants to ruin your day.
- You are allowed to: Use shortcuts; drive routes completely different to what BeamNav gives you; use nitro and change drive-modes; use sirens and honks; drive on roads the wrong way; drive off-road; customize UI apps/UI layout (BeamNG.drive Vanilla only)

category.name: Success
category.rules:
**General/Important Rules**

- Video proof **mandatory**. If a submission’s video is removed or otherwise unavailable the run will be removed retroactively.
- Time Trials must be started through the Main Menu and **not** in freeroam as the mission version. This is due to some missions having variations in the starting location, checkpoint quantities, and props.** - rule added/in effect Jan 10, 2023
- All submissions require some form of audible game audio.*
- All submissions require clear recordings, with functional framerates.**
- No timer exploits.
- No pausing the simulation/IGT.
- No simplified physics.
- No environmental manipulation (e.g., gravity, wind, etc.).
- Competitive scenario conditions are to be applied.
- Mods from the repository or any 3rd party mods are not allowed.

*Background audio like music or talking is allowed, but vehicle noise should still be audible.

**Recorded framerate consistently at ~20FPS or frequently dipping to below ~15FPS puts the submission at the risk of being rejected.

**Runs with IGT**

- Default IGT must be visible in recording.
- IGT displayed at the end of a mission is to be used as the submission time.
- If the default IGT is counting down: Subtract the time remaining from the scenario's original time cap to get your submission time.
- If there is no time displayed on the success screen, submit the last shown time of the IGT.

**Runs without IGT**
